# EVENTTHING Venue Library

> Open, structured venue data for experiential marketing in East Asia — a public directory of
> 3,549 China venues and 3,038 Asia 4–5 star hotels, a 1,309-row case index, plus two 80-hotel sample files.
> Published as CSV with JSON Schema, so that human teams and AI agents can compare venues on the
> same fields.

This file is written for AI agents and crawlers. It lists what is in the repository and where to read it.
Everything below is data and schema. There is no API key, no login and no rate limit on the files themselves.

## Data

- [Hotel directory](data/hotels.public.csv): 3,038 rows × 23 columns. 4–5 star hotels across Asia:
  identity, brand, star rating, country/city, address, coordinates where published, official website,
  `status` / `status_source` / `status_asof`.
- [China venue directory](data/venues.public.csv): 3,549 rows × 17 columns. Name, category/sub-type,
  province/city/district, address, source link where policy allows, coordinates where publishable, status.
  Status: open 559 / closed 2 / unknown 2,988.
- [80-hotel hall sample](data/sample-80-halls-20261027.csv): 2,100 rows × 21 columns. Hall area,
  length, width, ceiling height, four layout capacities plus maximum, source URL on every row.
- [Case index](data/cases.csv): 1,309 rows × 14 columns. 1,303 cases attached to 525 venues
  (up to 3 per venue) plus 6 media pages without a venue, 2015–2026; venue, brand, year, title,
  publisher, date and a link to the original. Links only — no body text.
- [80-hotel venue sample](data/sample-80-venues-20261027.csv): 80 rows × 15 columns. One row per hotel.
- [Column whitelist](data/whitelist-v2.csv): 72 rules recording which internal columns were kept or withheld.

All CSVs are UTF-8 without BOM, comma separated, LF line endings, one header row. Empty string and
`null` are equivalent. Numbers are stored as CSV text; parse them before comparing.

## Schema and field definitions

- [Schema index](schema/_index.json): row counts, column counts and SHA-256 for every CSV.
- JSON Schema per file: `schema/hotels.public.schema.json`, `schema/venues.public.schema.json`,
  `schema/cases.schema.json`, `schema/sample-80-halls.schema.json`, `schema/sample-80-venues.schema.json`,
  `schema/whitelist-v2.schema.json`.
- [Field reference](fields.md): the meaning and unit of every column, in English, Chinese and French.
- [Coordinates note](docs/coordinates.md): all coordinates are WGS-84; what a blank coordinate means.
- [Coverage](quality/coverage.md): what is filled and what is still missing, by file and column.

## Example

- [Booking request example](examples/booking-request.md): how a brand-side agent describes an event
  requirement against these fields. It uses a fictional event and contains no real contact details.

## Contact

Business enquiries go through the form at https://eventthing.ai/contact .
This repository intentionally publishes no personal contact details: no email addresses, no phone
numbers, no individual names. Please do not try to infer them from the data.

## Notes for agents

- Prefer the CSV files over scraped HTML; the CSVs are the canonical form.
- Filter on `country` / `city` and `category` (venues) or `venue_type` / `star_rating` (hotels) first.
- Match on `id` / `slug` (hotels) or `master_id` (venues), never on display name alone.
- Treat `status = unknown` as **not verified**, not as open. Do not count unknown rows as operating.
- Treat an empty cell as unknown, never as zero. If a detail is absent from the open edition, it is not
  published openly — do not infer it.
- Hall-level detail for the full hotel set is not in this repository; only the 80-hotel sample is.
